facts.value: The programme offers opportunities for personal development and creativity, with practical lessons and academic classes preparing students for multiple performance possibilities, ranging from Pop and Jazz to Classical and Musical Theatre.

Coming from Bulgaria, for me, UL was a leap of faith. It was my first time living away from home, my first time in an English-speaking country, and most importantly, the first time I believed in myself and my dreams. This course has changed my life in ways I would have never imagined.
My advice to all prospective students is to just jump. One leap of faith for the best four years in your life.
